svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.59k stars in total, about 1.96k a year earlier. jactionlint 361, mr boxington 826, aube 2077, fnox 2431, hk 1364, pitchfork 724, usage 1086, +5 more 725.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
